dogecoin.text: So, a good meme coin has to either reference a potent meme (@dogecoin, @pepecoineth), add a twist to a  derisked success (@ShibainuCoin @bonk_inu @dogwifcoin) or…bring a new potent meme into existence!

What’s the value of @dogecoin or @ShibainuCoin or even @Ripple or @litecoin? They might not be *entirely* without use but their price flows from the big Keynesian Beauty Pageant that also gives prices other more legitimized “investments”
